response.sql: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), shares AS (SELECT member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM major_counts), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.member_count) AS total_members, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - g.average_share) AS average_above_group_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN group_average AS g WHERE s.share > g.average_share
